Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: While the overall study involves genetic perturbations (GapmeR knockdown of DUBR), the mass spectrometry (RAP-MS) experiment specifically analyzes the protein-RNA interaction state (molecular state) of DUBR compared to control RNAs (U1 and Luciferase). The knockdown experiments were validated via qPCR, ATAC-seq, and RNA-seq, but not via the MS dataset provided (PXD057811).

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The proteomics part of this study is a RAP-MS (RNA Antisense Purification coupled with Mass Spectrometry) experiment. The primary goal was to identify protein interactors of the DUBR ncRNA compared to negative controls (Luciferase mRNA) and positive controls (U1 snRNA). Quantification was performed using iBAQ.
